_meta.area: Barangay San Juan Bautista, San Nicolas, Ilocos Norte
_meta.description: Seats only, deliberately no names. The Sangguniang Barangay composition (one Punong Barangay, seven Kagawad, one SK Chairperson) is set by RA 7160 and is therefore real; WHO holds each seat in this barangay has not been collected, and inventing names for real elected officials would be fabrication. A device claims a seat and that claim travels under the claimant's own display name.
_meta.authoritySource: PLACEHOLDER — this roster is not issued or verified by the barangay. Claiming a seat is an unverified assertion; see identity/RoleEvents.kt.
_meta.legalBasis: RA 7160 (Local Government Code of 1991) Sec. 387 — composition of the sangguniang barangay.
